paper: CSRNet: Dilated Convolutional Neural Networks for Understanding the Highly Congested Scenes
implementation_policy: independent implementation from the published architecture; no reference source files or weights are vendored; an official checkpoint may be evaluated only through a separate rights-gated research lane

checkpoint.conversion: raw legacy checkpoint unpickled only in a networkless, read-only, capability-dropped container; state_dict re-saved and thereafter loaded with weights_only=True

frontend: VGG-16 convolutional layers through conv4_3 with three max-pools
